name: FastMoss
summary: TikTok Shop data: products, shops, creators, videos and rankings, with sales and revenue estimates by region.

client_secret.description: The FastMoss client_secret from the developer Console, sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every call is a POST with a JSON body, including the reads.
Answers are {code, msg, data}; check code, not just the HTTP status. 30003 means the access-frequency limit was hit, 30002 a data limit.

Most list calls take filter, orderby, page (default 1) and pagesize (default 10, max 100), with page x pagesize capped (5000 for searches, 500 for rankings). Range filters are {min, max} objects; time ranges are Unix seconds.
Money fields are in the region's own currency, so revenue and price filters need a region (or seller_id).

endpoints.name: Search TikTok Shop products
endpoints.summary: Products by keyword and filters, with units sold, revenue, commission and creator counts.

filter.description: Filters: region, l1/l2/l3_category_id, seller_id, product_id, price_range, commission_rate_range, creator_count_range, units_sold_range, total_gmv_range, day7_units_sold_range, day7_gmv_range, launch_time_range, is_cross_border, is_fully_managed, is_new_listed, is_free_shipping, is_local_warehouse, is_top_selling, off_shelves (0 on sale, 1 off), promotion_channel (1 video, 2 live, 3 both).

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field one of day7_units_sold, day7_gmv, commission_rate, total_units_sold, total_gmv, creator_count (descending).

pagesize.description: 1 to 100, default 10; page x pagesize at most 5000.

notes: A read over POST. price_range, total_gmv_range and day7_gmv_range need region or seller_id.

endpoints.name: Get a product's daily sales trend
endpoints.summary: Daily sales for one product over the last N days.

endpoints.name: List a product's reviews

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field rating or review_id.

notes: A read over POST. data.total gives the record count for paging.

endpoints.name: Rank top-selling products
endpoints.summary: Top-selling TikTok Shop products for a day, week or month.

filter.description: region, category_id, and date_info {type: day|week|month, value: e.g. 2026-02-01, 2026-18 or 2026-02} (date_info required).

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field one of units_sold, gmv, total_units_sold, total_gmv, growth_rate.

pagesize.description: 1 to 100, default 10; page x pagesize at most 500.

endpoints.name: List product categories
endpoints.summary: Product category tree with the ids the filters take.

endpoints.name: Search TikTok creators
endpoints.summary: Creators by keyword and filters, with followers, video stats and e-commerce sales.

keywords.description: Search words, fuzzy matched, at most 140 characters.

filter.description: Filters: region, category_id, verify_type (1 normal, 2 blue V), creator_type (1 personal, 2 shop), follower_gender_type (0 mostly female, 1 mostly male), follower_age_type (1 18-24, 2 25-34, 3 35+), follower_range {min, max}, is_mcn_creator, is_ecommerce_creator.

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field one of follower_count, day28_follower_count, video_count, video_avg_play_count, video_avg_digg_count, day28_units_sold.

pagesize.description: 1 to 100, default 10; page x pagesize at most 5000.

endpoints.name: Search TikTok shops
endpoints.summary: Shops by keyword and filters, with sales and revenue.

filter.description: Filters: seller_name, seller_id, creator_uid, creator_unique_id (@handle), brand_name, rating_range, creator_range, is_sshop, is_local, category_id, region.

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field one of day7_units_sold, day7_gmv, total_units_sold, total_gmv.

pagesize.description: 10 to 100, default 10; page x pagesize at most 5000.

endpoints.name: Search TikTok videos
endpoints.summary: Videos by keyword and filters, with plays, likes, engagement and units sold.

keywords.description: Search words, fuzzy matched, at most 120 characters.

filter.description: create_time_range {min, max} in Unix seconds (required per the docs), plus region, is_ecommerce, creator_category_id, product_category_id, follower_count_range, play_count_range, digg_count_range, interact_rate_range (percent).

orderby.description: Sort, each {field, order}; field one of follower_count, create_time, play_count, digg_count, units_sold, interact_rate.

pagesize.description: 1 to 100, default 10; page x pagesize at most 5000.
